children: The Bank of Korea has issued a warning that the broad circulation of dollar-pegged cryptocurrencies in the local market could trigger capital outflows and put downward pressure on the won's exchange rate. According to ChainCatcher, the central bank said the trend could also increase currency volatility.

title: Bank of Korea Warns Dollar-Pegged Cryptocurrencies Could Pressure Won
